title: Stay up to date, even in the background
summary: More timely update checks and useful Windows notifications make new Scribe releases easier to discover.

items: When desktop notifications are enabled, updates found while Scribe is in the background can show a Windows notification with Install update and View changelog buttons.
Notification actions bring Scribe forward to review the update, read its changes or continue installation. Downloads and restarting still require your confirmation.
With automatic checks enabled, Scribe checks on every launch and when explicitly reopened from its shortcut or tray, then every 30 minutes while it stays running.
Background checks continue when Scribe is hidden in the system tray. Returning online or bringing Scribe back after sleep catches up when a check is due.
Update notifications avoid repeated alerts for the same version. Choosing Later keeps that update available in About without prompting again for it.
Offline profiles still start with automatic checks off. The explanation in About now clearly describes the schedule and background notifications.
A check made in an earlier session no longer delays update checks for several hours after reopening Scribe.
Opening an older update notification still provides a useful screen to check the latest release, even if its details are no longer loaded.
